narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -10.53 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1763-0.1807 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.1820; the first objective pays 1.24R at 0.1746.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1820 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.24 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 40/100 — liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $5.1M -1.0% below · short liq $1.7M +2.5% above

funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
